failure_stress.source: Scenario assumption of 30 MPa, not an extracted species-specific measurement. Material variability and required test conditions: USDA Wood Handbook Ch. 5, https://research.fs.usda.gov/treesearch/62244
failure_stress.assumption: 30 MPa is a conditional demonstration parameter; 20 to 60 MPa sensitivity range is illustrative and is not a statistical confidence interval. For a real log identify species, moisture, defects, grain and load rate before assigning a value.

assumptions: Central transverse point load on a simply supported beam; all other failure mechanisms ignored for this conditional calculation.
This is not a measured Captain America feat. Along-grain splitting, different grip geometry or pre-existing cracks require different models.
Output is a conditional failure force in newtons; there is no displacement history or damage energy and thus no TNT/tier claim.
